workspace.title: My workspace
workspace.blockedOwner: The platform owner has no staff record in a hospital, so there is nothing personal to show.
workspace.blockedHrOff: Staff & HR is not switched on for this hospital, so there is no staff record to show.
workspace.loadFailed: Your record could not be loaded: {{error}}
workspace.askHr: Ask HR to link your login to your staff record — until then only Account & security has anything to show.
workspace.tryLater: Try again in a moment; Account & security still works.

overview.awaitingHint: Leave, corrections, swaps and expense claims you send show here until they are decided.
overview.attentionHint: Licences running out, reviews on your turn and checklist tasks show here.
overview.noShiftsHint: Your shifts appear here once the roster is published.
overview.noPositionHint: Your department, designation and manager appear here once HR sets them.
overview.activityHint: Leave requests, corrections, swaps, claims and payslips show up here as they happen.

roster.noHolidaysHint: Nothing left on the holiday calendar.

leave.cancelApproved: The {{days}} go back to your balance.
leave.sayWhy: Say why in a few words.
leave.waitingOnYouSub: Leave requests at your step — approve to pass them on, or reject with a reason.
leave.balanceSub: What is in your balance, what is waiting for approval, and what you can take now.
leave.noTypes: No leave types apply to you yet
leave.noTypesHint: Balances appear once HR sets up the leave policy.
leave.requestsSub: Everything you have asked for, newest first.
leave.noRequestsHint: Apply for leave and it goes to your approver — the With column shows who has it.
leave.holidaysSub: The days the hospital observes as holidays.
leave.noHolidayHint: HR has not published one for this year.

payslips.deductionsSub: PF, ESI, PT, TDS and others
payslips.title: My payslips
payslips.subtitle: Every payslip released to you, newest first.
payslips.emptyHint: Your payslips appear here once a payroll run that includes you is approved.

expenses.approvedNote: Approved claims are paid by HR, or with your next salary.
expenses.title: My expense claims
expenses.subtitle: Spent money for the hospital? Claim it here with the bill.
expenses.noClaimsHint: A course fee, travel, a purchase for the ward — claim it with the bill and it goes for approval.
expenses.sentAttach: Claim sent for approval — attach the bill below.
expenses.savedDraft: Saved as a draft — attach the bill, then send it.

reviews.goalsHint: HR asks for the self-assessment once the goals are set.
reviews.sentTo: Sent to {{name}} — you will see the ratings once the review is closed.
reviews.selfIntro: Rate yourself on each goal and competency (1 = needs improvement, 5 = outstanding). Save for later, or send it to your manager when done.
reviews.tasksSub: Tick what you have done; HR sees it straight away.
reviews.forTeam: For the people who report to me
reviews.myReviewsSub: Your goals, your self-assessment and your manager’s rating, cycle by cycle.
reviews.reviewsIGiveSub: People who report to you — set their goals, then rate them.

documents.renewHint: Renewed it? Give HR the new copy — they update the record and the warnings stop.
documents.dueBanner_one: One of your licences or documents has expired or expires soon — {{titles}}. Renew it and give HR the new copy.
documents.dueBanner_other: {{count}} of your licences and documents have expired or expire soon — {{titles}}. Renew them and give HR the new copy.
documents.credSub: Registrations and certifications HR holds for you.
documents.docsSub: The documents HR holds against your record.

profile.blankNote: Most of your personal details are still blank — HR keeps these fields, so ask them to fill in your date of birth, address and emergency contact.
profile.emergencySub: Who the hospital calls if something happens at work.
profile.statutorySub: The numbers behind PF, ESI and tax on your payslip — use View details to see them in full.
profile.salarySub: Where your net pay is sent.
profile.noBankHint: Give HR your account details so salary can be paid by transfer.

account.signPinSet: Set — you sign consults and prescriptions with it.
account.signPinNotSet: Not set yet. You need it to sign consults.
account.kioskPinSet: Set — punch on any attendance kiosk with your employee code and this PIN.
account.kioskPinNotSet: Not set yet. You need it to punch on an attendance kiosk.
account.kioskPinWarn: Don’t share it — a punch made with it is yours. Several wrong PINs in a row lock your code on the kiosks for a few minutes.
account.changePasswordSub: Other devices are signed out when you change it.
account.newPasswordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
account.signInSecuritySub: Your confirmed email lets you reset a forgotten password and get sign-in codes.
account.emailVerifiedHint: You can reset a forgotten password from the sign-in page.
account.emailUnverifiedHint: Confirm it to reset a forgotten password yourself and to use sign-in codes.
account.emailCode: Or enter the code from the email
account.emailCodeSent: Sent to {{sentTo}}. Click “Confirm my email” in it — or type its code here (10 minutes).
account.twoStep: Ask for a code at every sign-in
account.twoStepHint: After your password, we email you a 6-digit code. Someone who knows your password still can’t get in.
account.twoStepRequired: Your role requires a code at every sign-in.
account.noPlatformEmail: The platform can’t send email yet, so these options are off for now.
account.myAccessSub: Roles are managed by your hospital’s administrator.

viewAs.hint: Shown as they see it. Nothing can be changed from here.
